  "publish_date": "2024-04-10",
  "reason_for_revision": "1) Added a new 3 Step-Age Heat Treatment category for Stage 1 & Stage 2 wheels.\n2) Added a specific ECI inspection interval for Stage 1 enhanced wheels with 2 Step-Age heat treatment.\n3) Added a specific ECI inspection interval for Stage 2 wheels post Rotor Life Extension.",
  "purpose": "Advise users to perform routine inspections at a maintenance interval based on installed configuration.",
  "compliance_category_code": "A",

  "recurring_indicator_if_found": null,
  "coarse_outage_type": "Inspection",
  "scope_of_work": [
    "Qualified vendor to perform CO2 blast cleaning of turbine rotor.",
    "GE Vernova qualified personnel to perform rotor inspections.",
    "Back-cut stage 1 and stage 2 turbine blades.",
    "Rotor inspection equipment and blend/peen kit are provided and applied by GE Vernova.",
    "Turbine blades should be removed prior to beginning these inspections per hot gas path outage scope.",
    "CO2 blast cleaning of turbine rotor can be completed in one shift (12 hours), including a prior hand wiping to remove oil from the dovetail surfaces if necessary.",
    "ECI of first and second stages can be completed in three shifts or all three stages in four shifts.",
    "Total time between turbine blade removal and installation should be four shifts (two days). These durations are estimates only."
  ],
  "service_recommendation_line_items": [
    "Perform routine inspections at a maintenance interval based on installed configuration (shot peening condition at first fire, cooling slot geometry, material heat treatment, and environmental conditions).",
    "If a cooling slot crack is detected during the inspection, immediate wheel replacement will be recommended to help avoid the risk of wheel post liberation during operation.",
    "Install back cut turbine blades on all turbine rotors.",
    "Apply dovetail modified (\"back cut\") Stage 1 and 2 turbine blades at the next scheduled maintenance (hot gas path inspection or major inspection).",
    "Perform dovetail ECI until rotor retirement at the frequency defined in the applicable configuration table (Tables 1 and 2).",
    "Prior to ECI, appropriately clean the turbine rotor to facilitate proper functioning of the ECI equipment and accurate readings (preferred method: dry ice (CO2) blasting; hand-cleaning acceptable if CO2 blast not available).",
    "Perform visual inspection (VT) / borescope inspection (BI) of accessible rotor surfaces; specifically examine broach slot fillets, slot bottoms, tangs, cooling slots, spacer rim seal tooth rubs/coating, balance weights, nut damage/surface indications in flanges and webs.",
    "Perform UT on counterbore outside diameter ligaments on distance piece and turbine aft shaft.",
    "Perform FPI to detect cracks on balance weights and lockwire tabs (not recommended for wheel posts).",
    "Stage 3 wheel (TW3) and turbine aft shaft (TAS) inspections: TW3 BWG (if staked: FPI every MI and when Exhaust Frame is removed during HGPI; if stakeless: no inspections necessary); TW3 LWT (if original: FPI every HGPI while buckets are removed; if modified: FPI every MI); TAS BWG (if staked: FPI every MI and when Exhaust Frame is removed during HGPI; if stakeless: no inspections necessary)."
  ],
  "completion_criteria_text": "This TIL is considered completed when the turbine wheels reach end of life and are removed from service.",
  "maintenance_trigger_text": "Routine inspections at a maintenance interval based on installed configuration; additional triggers include HGPI, Major Inspection (MI), and conditions such as whether CDC is removed and whether buckets are removed.",
  "recommended_interval_or_trigger": [
    "Stage 1/2 wheel post ECI intervals depend on configuration (material heat treatment, peening condition, cooling slot geometry, balance rail & lock wire tab) and are specified in the applicable configuration tables for 7F/9F/6F.",
    "For certain configurations: ECI every 24 hrs or 900 starts; ECI every 32 hrs or 1,200 starts [every 24 hrs or 900 starts if back cut buckets not installed]; ECI at 96 hrs or 3,600 starts [every 48 hrs or 2,400 starts if back cut buckets not installed]; BI every HGPI when CDC is not removed; FPI LWT every HGPI when buckets are removed; FPI BWG every Major and when CDC is removed during HGPI; some Stage 2 configurations add 'and at first Major after TW2 Life Extension'.",
    "Back-cut (dovetail modified) Stage 1 and 2 turbine blades: apply at the next scheduled maintenance (hot gas path inspection or major inspection).",
    "TW3/TAS: FPI intervals depend on staked vs stakeless and original vs modified features (every MI; every HGPI while buckets are removed; and when the Exhaust Frame is removed during HGPI)."

Tables provide configurations for 7F, 9F, and 6F (Stages 1 and 2). Stage 3 wheel (TW3) and turbine aft shaft (TAS) inspections apply regardless of frame size or part numbers.",

    "Remove turbine blades prior to beginning these inspections per hot gas path outage scope.",
    "Clean turbine rotor prior to ECI (preferred: dry ice (CO2) blasting; alternative: hand-cleaning).",
    "Perform ECI of first and second stages (or all three stages if elected) per durations stated.",
    "Perform Visual/BI/UT and FPI inspections on specified features when accessible per recommendations."

    "Perform visual inspection / borescope (BI) of accessible rotor surfaces; specifically examine broach slot fillets, slot bottoms, tangs, cooling slots; turbine blade cooling slots in wheel broach slots; spacer rim seal tooth rubs/coating; balance weights; nut damage or surface indications in flanges and webs.",
    "Perform UT on counterbore outside diameter ligaments on distance piece and turbine aft shaft.",
    "Perform FPI to detect cracks on balance weights and lockwire tabs (not recommended for wheel posts).",

    "Install back cut (dovetail modified) Stage 1 and 2 turbine blades on all turbine rotors; apply at the next scheduled maintenance (hot gas path inspection or major inspection).",

    "Rotor inspection equipment and blend/peen kit are provided and applied by GE Vernova.",
    "Turbine blades should be removed prior to beginning these inspections per hot gas path outage scope."

  "service_recommendation_line_items": [
    "Perform routine inspections at a maintenance interval based on installed configuration (shot peening condition at first fire, cooling slot geometry, material heat treatment, and environmental conditions).",
    "If a cooling slot crack is detected during the inspection, immediate wheel replacement will be recommended to help avoid the risk of wheel post liberation during operation.",
    "Perform dovetail ECI until rotor retirement at the frequency defined in the applicable configuration table (Stages 1 and 2 wheel posts identified in Tables 1 and 2; third stage wheel posts and turbine wheels with any cooling slot configuration may also be inspected with the same equipment, if elected).",

    "Perform visual inspection (VT) / borescope inspection (BI) of accessible rotor surfaces when available; for non-shot peened rotors, visual inspection of all exposed turbine rotor surfaces is recommended.",
    "Perform FPI to detect cracks on balance weights and lockwire tabs; do not use FPI for wheel posts (cracks under the dovetail tangs are typically closed).",

    "For lock wire tab fillets: perform FPI when turbine blades are removed during routine maintenance intervals.",
    "If crack-like indications are found, contact local GE Vernova service representative for disposition; in most cases, an in-situ repair procedure can be used to remove cracked lock wire tabs or balance weight stake marks; wheel replacement may be necessary if repair limits are exceeded.",
    "Install back cut turbine blades on all turbine rotors; apply dovetail modified (\"back cut\") Stage 1 and 2 turbine blades at the next scheduled maintenance (hot gas path inspection or major inspection).",
    "Stage 3 wheel (TW3) and turbine aft shaft (TAS) inspections (regardless of frame size or part numbers): TW3 balance weight grooves—if staked: FPI every Major Inspection (MI) and when the Exhaust Frame is removed during Hot Gas Path Inspection (HGPI); if stakeless: no inspections necessary.",
    "Stage 3 wheel (TW3) and turbine aft shaft (TAS) inspections (regardless of frame size or part numbers): TW3 lockwire tabs—if original: FPI every HGPI while buckets are removed; if modified: FPI every MI.",
    "Stage 3 wheel (TW3) and turbine aft shaft (TAS) inspections (regardless of frame size or part numbers): TAS balance weight grooves—if staked: FPI every MI and when the Exhaust Frame is removed during HGPI; if stakeless: no inspections necessary."

{
  "til_number": "TIL 1945-R2",
  "revision": "R2",
  "title": "F-CLASS TURBINE WHEEL INSPECTION AND MAINTENANCE RECOMMENDATIONS",
  "publish_date": "2024-07-15",
  "reason_for_revision": "1) Added a new 3 Step-Age Heat Treatment category for Stage 1 & Stage 2 wheels applicable to 7F and 6F.\n2) Added a specific ECI inspection interval for Stage 1 contoured and enhanced wheels with 2 Step-Age heat treatment,\n3) Added a specific ECI inspection interval for Stage 2 wheels post Rotor Life Extension.",
  "purpose": "Advise users to perform routine inspections at a maintenance interval based on installed configuration. This TIL supersedes TILs 1280, 1327, 1434, 1539, 1540, and 1742.",
  "compliance_category_code": "A",
  "compliance_category_text": null,
  "recurring_indicator_if_found": null,
  "coarse_outage_type": "Next Scheduled Outage",
  "scope_of_work": [
    "Remove turbine blades prior to beginning these inspections per hot gas path outage scope.",
    "Clean turbine rotor prior to ECI (preferred: dry ice (CO2) blasting; otherwise hand-cleaning acceptable) and perform ECI of turbine wheel posts per Tables 1-6."
  ],
  "service_recommendation_line_items": [
    "Determine installed turbine wheel configuration (shot peening condition at first fire, cooling slot geometry: original/contoured/enhanced, material heat treatment: 2SA/3SA, balance rail & lock wire tab condition) and follow the applicable inspection recommendations in Tables 1-6 for Stage 1 and Stage 2 wheels.",
    "Perform dovetail Eddy Current Inspection (ECI) for all wheel posts until rotor retirement at the frequency defined in Tables 1-6; ensure rotor is appropriately cleaned prior to ECI (preferred method: dry ice (CO2) blasting; surfaces must be free of oil beforehand).",
    "Perform Visual inspection / Borescope inspection (BI) / Ultrasonic (UT) as recommended (notably for non-shot peened rotors) focusing on broach slot fillets/slot bottoms/tangs/cooling slots, turbine blade cooling slots in wheel broach slots, spacer rim seal tooth rubs/coating, balance weights (looseness/migration/staking quality/tight set screw), nut damage or surface indications in flanges and webs, and UT of counterbore outside diameter ligaments on distance piece and turbine aft shaft.",
    "Perform Fluorescent Penetrant Inspection (FPI) on staked balance weight grooves and lock wire tab fillets at the stated maintenance intervals; do not use FPI for wheel posts (cracks under dovetail tangs are typically closed).",
    "If a cooling slot crack is detected during the inspection, replace the wheel immediately to avoid the risk of wheel post liberation during operation.",
    "Install dovetail modified (\"back cut\") Stage 1 and 2 turbine blades on all turbine rotors; apply at the next scheduled maintenance (hot gas path inspection or major inspection) and ensure inventory parts are modified via GE Vernova Service Center standard repair/refurbishment process.",
    "Use GE Vernova turbine blade technicians for turbine blade installation/removal to mitigate risk of lock wire tab damage; utilize appropriate blade installation and removal tools and techniques.",
    "For Stage 3 turbine wheel (TW3) and turbine aft shaft (TAS), apply inspections regardless of frame size or part numbers: TW3 BWG (if staked: FPI every MI and when Exhaust Frame removed during HGPI; if stakeless: none), TW3 LWT (if original: FPI every HGPI while buckets removed; if modified: FPI every MI), TAS BWG (if staked: FPI every MI and when Exhaust Frame removed during HGPI; if stakeless: none)."
  ],
  "completion_criteria_text": "This TIL is considered complete when the turbine wheels reach end of life and are removed from service.",
  "maintenance_trigger_text": "Routine inspections at a maintenance interval based on installed configuration; intervals are defined in Tables 1-6 and by maintenance events such as HGPI and Major Inspection (MI).",
  "recommended_interval_or_trigger": [
    "Per Tables 1-6: ECI/BI/FPI/UT intervals depend on wheel configuration and may be specified in operating hours (khrs), starts, and/or maintenance events (HGPI, Major Inspection, when CDC is removed, when buckets are removed).",
    "Stage 3 wheel and turbine aft shaft: FPI intervals depend on whether features are staked/stakeless and original/modified, and on maintenance events (HGPI, MI, Exhaust Frame removal)."
  ],
  "usage_counters_to_check_or_consider": [
    "operating_hours",
    "starts"
  ],
  "usage_counter_requirements_text": "Inspection intervals in Tables 1-6 are expressed in operating hours (hrs/khrs) and starts (e.g., \"every 24 khrs or 900 starts\", \"at 96 khrs or 3,750 starts [inspection window is 80-104 khrs]\").",
  "frame_or_model_applicability_text": "Select F-class gas turbine rotors (tables provided for 7F, 9F, and 6F; Stage 3 wheel and turbine aft shaft inspections apply regardless of frame size or part numbers).",
  "combustion_or_fuel_configuration_text": null,
  "hardware_or_part_configuration_text": "Inspection recommendations depend on installed configuration including shot peening condition at first fire (fired without shot peening / never fired without shot peening / peening modification requiring validation), cooling slot geometry (original/contoured/enhanced), material heat treatment (2 Step Age / 3 Step Age), and balance rail & lock wire tab condition (original vs stakeless & modified tab). Some intervals depend on whether back cut buckets are installed, whether CDC is removed during HGPI, and whether buckets are removed.",
  "serial_or_unit_applicability_text": "For \"Peening Modification\" wheels: \"Contact your GE Vernova representative with your turbine serial number\" (7F Stage 1) or \"turbine rotor serial number\" (7F Stage 2, 9F Stage 1/2) to determine applicable peening condition; until validated, assume \"Fired without Shot Peening\" recommendations apply.",
  "exclusions_or_non_applicable_conditions_text": "FPI is not recommended for the wheel posts, as cracks under the dovetail tangs are typically closed. For TW3 and TAS balance weight grooves: if stakeless, no inspections necessary.",
